*{{SCP|Smithing|60|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}}

===Rewards===
*[[Fremennik sea boots 3]]:
**Five daily teleports to the [[Rellekka]] marketplace
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*Roughly 18% increased experience and 25% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Rellekka Rooftop Course]]{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Lykos|url=https://discord.com/channels/177206626514632704/514602892292784139/1397002033911038144|date=21 July 2025|quote=for the Pollnivneach and Rellekka courses, there is a 1/3 chance to have the timer be two minutes if you've completed the hard tier of the respective diary|image=Lykos Desert and Frem diary mark of grace bonus.png|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27962785#chat-messages-514602892292784139-1397002033911038144|archivedate=2026-03-07}}
*[[Adamantite bar]]s from [[aviansie]] killed in the [[God Wars Dungeon]] are now [[noted]]
*[[Enchanted lyre]] and its [[Enchanted lyre(i)|imbued variant]] can now be played to teleport to [[Waterbirth Island]], aside from [[Rellekka]]
*Access to [[Tan Leather]] and [[Recharge Dragonstone]] from the [[Lunar spellbook]]
*[[Stony basalt]] now teleports you on top of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], past the [[Rocks (Troll Stronghold)|rocky shortcut]] (this requires 73 [[Agility]])
*[[Fossegrimen]] will [[enchanted lyre(i)|imbue your lyre]] with infinite charges for 400 of each required fish, down from 600
*Access to [[Bosun Zarah]] as a crewmate after the completion of [[Royal Trouble]] (requires 80 [[Sailing]])
